# HorizontalStackExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for horizontal stacks

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AlignCenter`](#aligncenter): Sets the vertical alignment to center
- [`AlignEnd`](#alignend): Sets the vertical alignment to the end
- [`AlignStart`](#alignstart): Sets the vertical alignment to the start
- [`AutoWidth`](#autowidth): Sets the width distribution to be based on the intrinsic width of the children
- [`EqualWidth`](#equalwidth): Sets the width distribution to be equal for all children
- [`Item`](#item): Adds a child element to the horizontal stack
- [`Spacing`](#spacing): Sets the spacing between elements in the horizontal stack
- [`WeightedWidth`](#weightedwidth): Sets the width distribution to be based on weights
